result.summary: The main issue is the loading state of the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' image, which displays an incomplete loading spinner overlay, suggesting a performance or rendering issue.

issues.description: A partially rendered or stuck loading spinner is visible over the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' banner image.
issues.suggestion: Check the image loading logic to ensure the overlay disappears once the content has successfully finished loading.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccolo' title and potentially its content at the far right of the 'Fastest near you' carousel might be partially clipped depending on the device screen width.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal padding or spacing of the carousel elements to ensure text remains fully visible without being truncated by the screen edge.
